Ladner Acreages: streets and boundaries

items.t: The acreage ground is the farm fabric south and west of Ladner village: parcels along Ladner Trunk Road, 64 Street and the roads toward Westham Island, in the City of Delta.

blocks.text: Ladner Acreages: the housing stock

items.t: A1 allows one farm house per lot, maximum 500 square metres (m²), on a farm home plate capped at 3,600 m², or 5,000 m² where an additional farm house also sits on the plate.
Water for fields comes from the City ditch system in summer irrigation mode; homes not on community sewer use an onsite system under the Sewerage System Regulation, per Fraser Health.

blocks.text: Ladner Acreages: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Subdivision in A1 needs a minimum new lot of 8 hectares (ha), Official Community Plan (OCP) compliance and, in the ALR, Agricultural Land Commission (ALC) approval, apart from the ALC home site severance exception.
A second dwelling is one accessory farm dwelling unit per lot: 90 m² maximum on lots of 40 ha or less, 186 m² over 40 ha, on the same farm home plate; more needs ALC approval.
Non-domestic groundwater, including irrigation from a well, needs a water licence under the Water Sustainability Act before lawful use; domestic use does not.

blocks.text: Ladner Acreages: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Delta's farm ditches work two ways: drainage mode in winter, irrigation mode in summer, with City control gates regulating water levels for crops.
Equestrian use in A1 is capped at 40 permanent stalls as an accessory use to farming.

blocks.text: Ladner Acreages: development and new projects

items.t: 84 Street Drainage Pump Station, Ladner Trunk Road catchment, City of Delta with federal Disaster Mitigation and Adaptation Fund support of $7.6 million toward two stations: it will pump stormwater through a force main to the Boundary Bay dike, addressing flooding of low-lying fields and crop losses in this catchment. Status: contribution agreement before Council October 29, 2024, projects to be completed by 2032 (as of November 3, 2026).

blocks.text: Ladner Acreages: costs and taxes

items.t: Flat-rate utilities for 2026 total $1,658 for a single-family home, up $51 from 2025; metered water and sewer are billed quarterly. Farm parcels on wells or septic do not carry the same utility bill, so confirm which services the parcel actually has.

Development Cost Charges (DCCs) apply on subdivision or a non-residential building permit under DCC Bylaw No. 7560; the intensive-agriculture rate is charged per square metre of gross floor area, so a large barn or greenhouse carries a DCC cost a house lot does not (check the current schedule).
